what: Speech recognition on the hub: fp32 (transformers pipeline, as v1 ships) against int8 (CTranslate2, PHC_ASR=ct2), each in a fresh process of the phc-scribe-api image

found_and_fixed: Before the fix, int8 decoded one ~30 s window of a 33 s Pidgin recording into 13 words (fp32: 78). At windows of at most 20 s the two matched (78 = 78; at 15 s 80 = 80). Serving now cuts recordings over 20 s at pauses into windows of at most 20 s (INT8_WINDOW_S), and the dev check was re-run with the same windows.
